instruction: Configure VS Code to enable the integrated terminal's copy on selection feature and set the cursor style to underline.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to configure integrated terminal settings. The evaluator checks that 'terminal.integrated.copyOnSelection' is true and 'terminal.integrated.cursorStyle' is set to 'underline'. These settings affect terminal behavior and appearance.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VS Code settings file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric correctly loads JSON and verifies all expected key-value pairs with exact matching
Complete coverage: Both requirements verified (terminal.integrated.copyOnSelection=true and terminal.integrated.cursorStyle=underline)
Expected values are semantically correct and match instruction requirements
Proper data flow: getter extracts file path -> metric loads JSON -> compares settings -> returns score
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: accesses expected['expected'] from rules dict (returned by get_rule)
No postconfig needed since VS Code settings persist to disk automatically

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
